arxiv-2008-09893.creator: Satyanu Bhadra, Shankar Ghosh
arxiv-2008-09893.description: Abstract A ball dropped from a given height onto a surface, will bounce repeatedly before coming to rest. A ball bouncing on a thick plate will behave very differently than a ball bouncing off the thin lid of a container.

arxiv-2109-13876.title: An exact test for significance of clusters in binary data
arxiv-2109-13876.creator: James Mathews, Cameron Crowe, Rami Vanguri, Margaret Callahan, Travis Hollmann, Saad Nadeem
arxiv-2109-13876.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by James Mathews, Cameron Crowe, Rami Vanguri, Margaret Callahan, Travis Hollmann, Saad Nadeem. Unsupervised clustering of feature matrix data is an indispensible technique for exploratory data analysis and quality control of experimental data. However, clusters are difficult to assess for statistical significance in an objective way. We prove a formula for the distribution of the size of the set of samples, out of a population of fixed size, which display a given signature, conditional on the marginals (frequencies) of each individual feature comprising the signature.

arxiv-2304-04299.title: The Effect of Flagella Stiffness on the Locomotion of a Multi-Flagellated Robot at Low Reynolds Environment
arxiv-2304-04299.creator: Nnamdi Chikere, Yasemin Ozkan-Aydin, Member, IEEE
arxiv-2304-04299.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Nnamdi Chikere, Yasemin Ozkan-Aydin, Member, IEEE. Microorganisms such as algae and bacteria move in a viscous environment with extremely low Reynolds ( R ​ e Re ), where the viscous drag dominates the inertial forces. They have adapted to this environment by developing specialized features such as whole-body deformations and flexible structures such as flagella (with various shapes, sizes, and numbers) that break the symmetry during the motion.

arxiv-2310-03169.title: Metadynamics calculations of the effect of thermal spin fluctuations on skyrmion stability
arxiv-2310-03169.creator: Ioannis Charalampidis, Joseph Barker
arxiv-2310-03169.description: Abstract The stability of magnetic skyrmions has been investigated in the past, but mostly in the absence of thermal fluctuations. However, thermal spin fluctuations modify the magnetic properties (exchange stiffness, Dzyaloshinskii–Moriya interaction (DMI) and anisotropy) that define skyrmion stability. Thermal magnons also excite internal skrymion dynamics, deforming the skyrmion shape.

arxiv-2312-01903.title: Substellar science in the wake of the ESA Euclid space mission
arxiv-2312-01903.creator: Eduardo L. Martín 1, Hervé Bouy 2, Diego Martín 1, Marusa Zerjal 1, Jerry J.-Y. Zhang 1, Adam Burgasser 3, Javier Olivares 4, Nicolas Lodieu 1, Enrique Solano 5, Patricia Cruz 5, David Barrado 5, Nuria Huélamo 5, Pedro Mas-Buitrago 5, Maria Morales 5, Carlos del Burgo 1, Alberto Escobar 1, Víctor Sá
arxiv-2312-01903.description: Abstract The ESA space mission Euclid was launched on July 1st, 2023 and is undergoing its science verification phase. In this invited review we show that Euclid means a ‘before’ and an ‘after’ for our understanding of ultra-cool dwarfs and substellar-mass objects and their connections with stars, exoplanets and the Milky Way.

arxiv-2410-05102.creator: Fenia Christopoulou, Ronald Cardenas, Gerasimos Lampouras, Haitham Bou-Ammar, Jun Wang
arxiv-2410-05102.description: Abstract Direct alignment algorithms have proven an effective step for aligning language models to human-desired behaviors. Current variants of the Direct Preference Optimization objective have focused on a strict setting where all tokens are contributing signals of KL divergence and rewards to the loss function.

arxiv-2501-02535.title: A completely uniform transformer for parity
arxiv-2501-02535.creator: Alexander Kozachinskiy, Tomasz Steifer
arxiv-2501-02535.description: Abstract We construct a 3-layer constant-dimension transformer, recognizing the parity language, where neither parameter matrices nor the positional encoding depend on the input length. This improves upon a construction of Chiang and Cholak who use a positional encoding, depending on the input length (but their construction has 2 layers).

arxiv-2512-17182.title: Long-time stability and convergence analysis of an IMEX BDF3 scheme for 2-D incompressible Navier-Stokes equation
arxiv-2512-17182.creator: Kelong Cheng, Jingwei Sun, Hong Zhang
arxiv-2512-17182.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Kelong Cheng, Jingwei Sun, Hong Zhang. High-order time-stepping schemes are crucial for simulating incompressible fluid flows due to their ability to capture complex turbulent behavior and unsteady motion. In this work, we propose a third-order accurate numerical scheme for the two-dimensional incompressible Navier-Stokes equation. Spatial and temporal discretization is achieved using Fourier pseudo-spectral approximation and the BDF3 stencil, combined with the Adams-Bashforth extrapolation for the nonlinear convection term, resulting in a semi-implicit, fully discrete formulation.

Quantum computing improves substantially on known classical algorithms for various important problems, but the nature of the relationship between quantum and classical computing is not yet fully understood.
